description: This OpenFEMA dataset gives applicant-level records for FEMA's Individuals and Households Program (IHP), with personal information removed and locations given by county, city and ZIP code, for valid registrations in all major disasters from declaration DR-1439 in 2002 to those declared more than 30 days ago. When read it held about 26.2 million records; the full set is refreshed annually and disasters from the last 18 months weekly, and keywords include housing and other needs assistance, owners and renters, flood, damage, amounts and demographics. The IHP meets basic needs after disasters and does not aim to restore damaged property to its pre-disaster state. A related aggregated dataset, Housing Assistance Program Data for owners, reports inspections, damage severity and assistance by ZIP code from 2004. Coverage: U.S. major disaster declarations. Access: API and downloads through OpenFEMA. Licence: OpenFEMA terms; free. Caveats: data are raw, self-reported and not an official federal report, and financial figures can differ from official systems. Simulation uses are household-level damage and recovery assistance data for validating housing loss and recovery models. Related records: NFIP Redacted Claims.
